docs.title: Health Records Documentation
docs.text:
Warning: This content is AI inspired.

Welcome to the documentation for the Health Records project. This project is currently in testing and provides a way to upload medical test PDFs, parse them, and view structured results.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• PDF Parsing and Text Extraction
  • AI-Powered Analysis using Gemini
  • Structured Database Storage
  • Interactive Dashboard (Frontend)

docs.title: Backend Architecture
docs.text:
Warning: This content is AI inspired.

The backend uses FastAPI and sqlite.

docs.title: System Architecture
docs.text:
graph TD
    Client(Client) --> FastAPI(FastAPI App)
    FastAPI --> PDFExtractor(PDF Extractor)
    FastAPI --> LLMParser(LLM Parser)
    LLMParser --> GeminiAPI(Gemini API)
    FastAPI --> Database(SQLite DB)

docs.title: Backend Design
docs.text:
Warning: This content is AI inspired.

The design focuses on modularity. We use: - pdf_extractor: uses pdfplumber for extracting text. - llm_parser: uses google-genai to parse text into structured JSON. - database: uses sqlite3 to store upload records. - models: Pydantic models for structured output schema.

docs.title: Component Interaction
docs.text:
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Main
    participant Extractor
    participant LLM
    participant DB
    User->>Main: POST /analyze (PDF)
    Main->>Extractor: extract_text()
    Extractor-->>Main: raw text
    Main->>LLM: parse_report(text)
    LLM-->>Main: HealthReport model
    Main->>DB: save_upload()
    DB-->>Main: record_id
    Main-->>User: JSON response

docs.title: Functional Requirements
docs.text:
• Expose a POST /analyze endpoint that accepts a PDF file.
  • Use pdfplumber to extract text.
  • Use Gemini API with structured JSON output capabilities.
  • Persist analysis results into an SQLite database.
  • Provide a GET /uploads endpoint to list past records.

docs.title: Frontend Architecture
docs.text:
Warning: This content is AI inspired.

The frontend is a Next.js (React) application.

docs.title: Frontend Modules
docs.text:
graph TD
    App(Next.js App) --> Page(Home Page)
    Page --> UploadZone(UploadZone)
    Page --> ResultsDashboard(ResultsDashboard)
    ResultsDashboard --> MarkerChart(MarkerChart)
    App --> API(API Functions)

docs.title: Frontend Design
docs.text:
Warning: This content is AI inspired.

  • UploadZone: Provides a drag-and-drop or file selection area for PDFs.
  • ResultsDashboard: Displays the patient summary and suggested fixes.
  • MarkerChart: Uses a charting library to visualize biomarker levels (Low, Normal, High).

docs.title: Component Flow
docs.text:
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant UploadZone
    participant API
    participant ResultsDashboard
    User->>UploadZone: Selects PDF file
    UploadZone->>API: Uploads file to backend
    API-->>UploadZone: Returns HealthReport JSON
    UploadZone->>ResultsDashboard: Passes data
    ResultsDashboard-->>User: Renders dashboard & charts

docs.title: Functional Requirements
docs.text:
• Connect to localhost:8000 FastAPI backend.
  • Allow users to upload .pdf documents.
  • Display errors gracefully if the PDF parsing fails.
  • Show an overall analysis summary.
  • Visualize markers and their statuses.
  • Suggest actionable advice for the patient.
